The '''Hero of Truth''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|真実|しんじつ}}の{{ruby|勇者|ゆうしゃ}}''' ''Hero of Truth'')  and the '''Hero of Ideals''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|理想|りそう}}の{{ruby|勇者|ゆうしゃ}}''' ''Hero of Ideals''), also collectively known as the '''twin heroes''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|双子|ふたご}}の{{ruby|英雄|えいゆう}}''' ''twin heroes'') , are characters from the backstory of {{game|Black and White|s}}.

==In the core series games==
===History===
====Backstory====
In mythologies, the twin heroes are said to have used a [[List of disputed and unidentified Pokémon#The single dragon|single, powerful dragon]] to create the [[Unova]] [[region]]; however, the brothers each sought something different for the region—truth for the older brother and ideals for the younger—this caused an arguing and then a fight over whose side was right. In response, the dragon split into [[Tao trio|three Pokémon]]: its truth, {{p|Reshiram}}; its ideals, {{p|Zekrom}}; and its leftover shell, {{p|Kyurem}}. Reshiram then sided with the older twin brother while Zekrom sided with the younger twin.

The two dragons were equally matched and neither conquered the other. Eventually, the brothers set aside their differences and equally declared that there was no right side. In the future however, the sons of the heroes resumed their fight, using Reshiram and Zekrom, completly destroying the region during the conflict with their fire and lightning powers. The second battle led to the original heroes to seal away their dragons within spherical stone known as [[Dragon Stones]], Reshiram in the [[Light Stone]] and Zekrom in the [[Dark Stone]].

It's implied that one of the heroes constructed the [[Relic Castle]] over 2,500 years ago.

===={{game|Black and White|s}}====
The conflict between truth and ideals repeats itself during the events of {{game|Black and White|s}}, the king of [[Team Plasma]], [[N]], sought the Dark Stone{{sup/5|B}}/Light Stone{{sup/5|W}} to revive {{p|Zekrom}}{{sup/5|B}}/{{p|Reshiram}}{{sup/5|W}} and create a world where humans and Pokémon live separately while {{ga|Hilda}}/{{ga|Hilbert}} obtained the Light Stone{{sup/5|B}}/Black Stone{{sup/5|W}} to stop N and allow humans and Pokémon and keep coexisting.

==In the spin-off games==
==={{g|Masters EX}}===
Even though the two brothers themselves never appear, in the present day, {{mas|Hilbert}} and {{mas|N}} became their successors and are seen as the new heroes of truth and ideals respectively.

==In animation==
[[File:King of the Vale M14.png|thumb|250px|[[King of the People of the Vale|The father of the heroes]] in [[M14|the fourteenth movie]]]]
===''[[Pokémon the Series]]''===
====''[[M14|White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram]]''====
The Heroes of Truth and Ideals were the sons of the [[King of the People of the Vale|king]] of the [[Kingdom of the Vale]] and lived one thousand years ago in the [[Unova]] [[region]]. The twins also commanded [[Legendary Pokémon]], the Hero of Truth possessed the [[Pokémon category|Vast White Pokémon]] [[Reshiram (M14)|Reshiram]] and the Hero of Ideals possessed the [[Pokémon category|Deep Black Pokémon]] [[Zekrom (M14)|Zekrom]]. 

One day, the two brothers began to fight over their beliefs and started a war in the process. This devastated the kingdom and caused the [[Dragon Force]] energy that was enriching their kingdom to become corrupted, turning into a destructive and chaotic force that destroyed the land. 

The chaos the Dragon Force caused forced their father to use his {{OBP|Victini|M14}}'s power to move the [[Sword of the Vale]] to the location that would eventually become Eindoak Town. Despite managing to calm the Dragon Force, the King unfortunately died soon after, accidentally leaving Victini trapped inside of the Sword of the Vale's barrier. Reshiram and Zekrom, exhausted from their battle, reverted into spherical stones known as [[Dragon Stones]]. Guilt ridden, the brothers took and hid the stones in a secret cave hidden deep underneath the castle.{{-}}The conflict between truth and ideals repeats itself during the events of the movie, where a descendant of the People of the Vale, [[Damon]] finds the [[Light Stone]]/[[Dark Stone]] underneath the Sword of the Vale and awakened Reshiram/Zekrom to help him restore the Kingdom of the Vale by moving the castle with Victini's power while [[Ash Ketchum|Ash]] finds the Dark Stone/Light Stone and awakens Zekrom/Reshiram to help him stop Damos and save Victini.

==In the manga==
[[File:Heroes of Truth and Ideals Adventures.png|thumb|250px|The Heroes of Truth and Ideals in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]]
===[[Pokémon Adventures]]===
====Background====
Thousands of years ago, the Heroes of Truth and Ideals were twin brothers who created the [[Unova]] [[region]] using a [[List of disputed and unidentified Pokémon#The single dragon|single, powerful dragon]] and eventually the two brothers argued over how to rule the region. The older brother pursued the truth while the younger brother pursued ideals. Unable to choose a side, the Dragon Pokémon split into two beings: {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}}, who sided with the older brother, and {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}}, who sided with the younger brother. Sometime after the two brothers battled, Reshiram and Zekrom transformed into spherical stones known as [[Dragon Stones]].

===={{MangaArc|Black & White}}====
The conflict between truth and ideals repeats itself in the present day, the king of [[Team Plasma]], [[N (Adventures)|N]], sought the [[Dark Stone]] to revive [[Tao trio (Adventures)#Zekrom|Zekrom]] and create a world where humans and Pokémon live separately while [[Black (Adventures)|Black]] obtained the [[Light Stone]] to stop N and allow humans and Pokémon and keep coexisting.

==Origin==
The legend of the twin heroes parallels the Roman myth of {{wp|Romulus and Remus}}, two twins who founded the city of Rome. Likewise, the twin heroes built the Relic Castle, which became the center of civilization in Unova at least 2,500 years ago, much like Rome in real-life ancient Europe. The twin heroes' disagreements leading to a fight also parallels the Roman myth.
